ns2:course.label: Science of Fermented Foods
ns2:course.description: Discusses the evolution and commercialization of fermented foods. Provides insight into the microbial processing, manufacturing, history, nutrition, safety, and chemistry of different fermented products such as beer, bread, wine, and cheese. Credit is not given for both FSHN 175 and FSHN 471. Prerequisite: FSHN 175 is intended for non-FSHN majors only.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both FSHN 175 and FSHN 471. Prerequisite: FSHN 175 is intended for non-FSHN majors only.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Not intended for students in the Food Science & Human Nutrition department.
